items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I recorded with Pete and with these people.

ctx.x: Well, before we leave, I'd like to have you mention something about Pete Brown. What kind of a player was he? Mention some of these and describe some of these great musicians that you played with.
Well, as I digested the music and the new music later on, I recorded with Pete and with these people.
But what kind of player was he, Cliff?
